name: @repo/svg-draw-on-scroll
description: An SVG path that draws itself as you scroll, optionally with a marker riding the tip.

useCases: Route or timeline illustrations that draw in as you scroll
Signature or underline flourishes tied to reading progress
Diagram connectors that draw sequentially across multiple paths
compositionHints: Pair with scroll-progress for a combined line-drawing + percentage indicator
Feed multiple paths to draw a route step by step
